risks.title: Geographic concentration of loan portfolio
risks.score_rationale: The concentration of our loan portfolio in Long Island and Manhattan real estate properties could negatively impact our financial condition and operating results in the event of a decline in economic conditions or real estate values in this region.

risks.title: Housing regulation and rent control
risks.score_rationale: Housing regulations, such as rent control laws, may negatively impact the value of our multifamily real estate loans and the ability of our borrowers to repay their loans.

risks.title: Credit risk of the portfolio
risks.score_rationale: Our loan portfolio is exposed to elevated credit risk due to the concentration of real estate loans and reliance on the success of borrowers' operations.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates may negatively impact our profitability due to our business model's reliance on interest rates.

risks.title: Banking regulation risk
risks.score_rationale: Banking and financial regulations may negatively impact our financial condition and operating results due to the need to comply with these regulations.

risks.title: Environmental risk in the real estate portfolio
risks.score_rationale: Our loan portfolio is exposed to environmental risk due to the possibility of contamination of real estate properties by hazardous substances.

risks.title: Reputational risk
risks.score_rationale: Reputational risk may negatively impact our financial condition and operating results due to loss of customer and investor confidence.
